items.title: Basic color roles
items.when_to_use: Choosing primary, secondary, and accent colors
items.body: Use about 60% primary, 30% secondary, and 10% accent. Prefer one hue family for UI chrome; reserve high contrast for CTAs.

items.title: Basic composition
items.body: Establish one clear focal point, group related content, and keep margins consistent across the frame.
